title: Stages.
officialText: Stages greater than 1,000 square feet in area (93 m2) and any assembly occupancy with a stage and an occupant load of 1,000 or greater shall be equipped with a Class III wet standpipe system with 1½-inch and 2½-inch (38 mm and 64 mm) hose connections on each side of the stage.
